name: Mimosa Mall Master Cubers 2022

venue.name: Mimosa Mall
venue.details: Open floor area set up in a shopping mall

information: Register for the first WCA Speedcubing Competition in the Free State, being hosted by Mimosa Mall in Bloemfontein! Volunteering We will need your help as volunteers to support with the running, judging and scrambling of the day. If you would like to volunteer to help staff at the competition, please contact [Maverick Pearson](mpearson@worldcubeassociation.org). Groups will be assigned so that volunteer duties don't clash with your competing. Cube Shop Cape Town's own cube shop, [Speedcubes.co.za](https://www.speedcubes.co.za), will have a stall open at the competition to sell a variety of puzzles. Check out their website to see what's available!
